Failure t o submit this certificate in the required format/unfilled parameters may lead to rejection of the offer. No fu rther claim of the bidder will be admissible in such cases. 9. No claim/repres entation of the bidder shall be admissible in such cases. 10. This period of 12 months shall be counted wit h respect to date of tender closing. 11. Contact details [Name/Designation/Official email/Mobile no.] of the issuing authority must b e provided by the bidder if asked for, failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. 12.
